name: mionet_77k
description: The reported 77k network (64 x 7 SiLU), seeds 42-45, Adam stage. Hyperparameters from the roll-out HPO runs/hpo_study (originally hpo_rollout_wk25r). Seed 42 was trained in study "wk25r" (num_batches "auto", which chose 32), seeds 43-45 in study "wk25rcv" with num_batches fixed to 32; the run folders were renamed from wk25r_s42 / wk25rcv_s43..45. The L-BFGS refinement is not used by the paper.
